description: This file defines the ISC_History module for the SmartClient framework, including version info, licensing, module initialization, and history management functions.

classes.name: History
classes.description: Provides methods for managing browser history within the SmartClient framework, including callback registration, history state management, and URL manipulation.

methods.name: registerCallback
methods.description: Registers callback functions for history events.

methods.name: getCurrentHistoryId
methods.description: Returns the current history entry ID based on URL.

methods.name: addHistoryEntry
methods.description: Adds a new entry to the browser history with specified ID and data.

methods.name: historyCallback
methods.description: Invokes the registered callback when history state changes.
